## Queue Horn 1.0

First release.

- Alerts when the Dungeon Finder or Raid Finder has a group for you, when someone else starts a ready check, when a battleground or arena is ready and when a pet battle match is found.
- Every alert plays one sound on the Master channel, so you hear it even with the effects sound turned down, flashes the game icon in your taskbar or dock and shows a short message in the middle of the screen.
- The same alert never plays twice within 5 seconds. A battleground or arena queue is announced once per pop.
- Each alert and the icon flash can be switched on or off: `/qh lfg off`, `/qh ready off`, `/qh pvp off`, `/qh pet off`, `/qh flash off`.
- `/qh` or `/queuehorn` shows the settings, `/qh test` plays the alert once. Settings are shared by all your characters.

## Queue Horn 1.1

- New: **choose the sound for each alert**. Five sounds of the game to pick from: horn, warning, alarm, invite and whisper.
- `/qh sound` lists the sound of every alert and the choices. `/qh sound lfg alarm` gives the Group Finder alert the alarm and plays it once so you hear it. The same works for `ready`, `pvp` and `pet`.
- `/qh test lfg` (or `ready`, `pvp`, `pet`) plays the full test alert with the sound chosen for it. `/qh test` on its own works as before.
- Every alert keeps the horn until you choose another sound, so nothing changes unless you want it to. Your settings from 1.0 are kept.

## Queue Horn 1.2

- New: **screen flash for each alert**. A coloured glow at the edges of your screen fades in and out three times, so you see the alert even with the sound off. Four colours to pick from: red, gold, blue and green.
- `/qh flash` lists the screen flash of every alert. `/qh flash ready red` gives the ready check a red flash and shows it once so you see it. `/qh flash ready off` takes it away again. The same works for `lfg`, `pvp` and `pet`.
- `/qh test ready` (or `lfg`, `pvp`, `pet`) now shows the screen flash of that alert too.
- The flash takes no clicks and works in combat. Flashing the game icon in your taskbar or dock stays as it was: `/qh flash on` and `/qh flash off` still switch it.
- Every alert starts without a screen flash, so nothing changes unless you want it to. Your settings from 1.1 are kept.

## Queue Horn 1.3

- Queue Horn now speaks **German**. On clients in other languages it stays in English.
- The alerts are named the way the game itself names them, in your client's language: Group Finder, Ready Check, Battleground and Arena, Pet Battle. On English clients they are now written with capital letters, for example "Ready Check" instead of "Ready check".
- The hint about the game's "Sound in Background" option names that option exactly as your sound settings do.
- The commands stay the same in every language, and so do the sound and colour names you type, for example `/qh sound lfg alarm` or `/qh flash ready red`.
- Your settings, sounds and screen flash colours from 1.2 are kept.
